label: Landscape — golden hour
brief: Warm, directional low sun. Protect highlight detail in the sun and the sky around it; let shadows stay rich but open. Keep the warmth of the light: do not neutralise the white balance. Avoid an orange cast on foliage greens. Prefer contrast in the midtones (texture, a little clarity) over global contrast.
convergence_hints: stop when the sky gradient is smooth and the area around the sun holds detail
stop when foliage greens are green, not orange
